frozen_by: assembled for BENCH-03 from evidence/frozen-instances-2026-10-01.json: the seven declared cells copied verbatim (id, family, suite, class, split, sha256, present) after re-hashing each working-tree file; refusal on any mismatch
purpose: BENCH-03 declared subset — the LP-01 deferred set (bore3d, scsd1, scsd6, blend), the GAP-01 model (etamacro) and the two MPS-rim models (e226, grow7) whose campaign rows are the standing "still failing honestly" open item in docs/project/STATUS.md

successor_of.relation: subset of the 2026-10-01 successor manifest; entry bytes and sha256 unchanged, splits and timing vocabulary copied unchanged

split.alias_note: ml_splits train/validation/test are reported here as train/tune/holdout

timing_scope.process_wall: Parent-observed wall clock around the solver process, including model parse, CLI start-up and result serialisation.
timing_scope.engine_only: Time reported by the solver engine itself, excluding parse/start-up; not comparable across solvers and never mixed into cross-solver rows.

cold_vs_repeat.cold: First solve of an instance by a solver in a run: fresh process, no reused basis, no warm OS page cache for the model file.
cold_vs_repeat.repeat: Any later solve of the same instance by the same solver in the same run: warm; reported separately and never averaged with the cold row.

defaults_status.name: lp_qp_time_limit_s
defaults_status.harness_default: run_full_compare --timeout default 60 s; run_full_benchmark --timeout default 60 s for the netlib and qplib suites
defaults_status.note: Both harnesses take the value from this module when --timeout is unset.

defaults_status.name: mip_time_limit_s
defaults_status.harness_default: run_full_benchmark --timeout default 300 s for the miplib, mittelmann and cases suites; run_full_compare applies one shared --timeout (default 60 s) to every class
defaults_status.note: run_full_compare cannot vary the cap per class without rewriting its shared report text, so MILP rows of a default compare run are LP-capped; pass --timeout 300 to apply the frozen MILP cap to that harness.

defaults_status.name: release_mip_time_limit_s
defaults_status.harness_default: not used by the diagnostic harnesses
defaults_status.note: Release-campaign cap; recorded so a release run is not confused with the 300 s diagnostic cap.

defaults_status.name: min_repeats
defaults_status.harness_default: run_full_compare and run_full_benchmark are single-shot; run_compare --repeat defaults to 3
defaults_status.note: Roadmap asks for >=5 repeats per reported cell; the frozen baseline is single-shot, so its timings are cold single observations, not medians.

defaults_status.name: matched_threads
defaults_status.note: Threads are matched across solvers so wall-clock rows are comparable.

defaults_status.name: timing_scope
defaults_status.harness_default: both harnesses measure the parent wall clock around the solver process
defaults_status.note: Process-wall only; engine-only numbers stay in solver-native reports.

defaults_status.name: cold_vs_repeat
defaults_status.harness_default: first (and only) observation per instance/solver cell
defaults_status.note: Single-shot runs are cold by construction; warm repeats are a follow-up.
